summary: Energy Company of Paraná (COPEL) filed a Form 6-K reporting a 2.1% increase in billed grid market for 1Q26 and a 2.5% rise in electricity consumption compared to the same period last year, driven by residential and commercial demand. This is a routine operational update with no special-situation characteristics such as acquisitions, divestitures, or shareholder meetings. The filing contains only financial and operational metrics, with no mention of any transaction, restructuring, or management change.
